note: Scripted baselines and legal-random officers, 2026-11-13, swat/shout-hearing (heard commands, role contract v5), Linux cloud container (4 vCPU, CPU only). 20 jobs in 470 s wall on 4 threads
roe: roe_violations merges protected_violations (force on protected people or officers) and lethal force on a person who was not a perceived lethal threat, per officer engagement
reloads: reloads_completed, reloads_interrupted and dry_decisions are per officer per episode; dry_decisions counts decisions begun alive with an empty weapon, not reloading, while it had a spare magazine
reload_pressure: officer_* and suspect_* reload metrics are per officer and per suspect per episode, over every officer and suspect in the sim: reloads started while seeing an armed enemy, reloads broken by damage or a sprint (reload-disturbed event), deaths with a reload in progress, reloads completed
ci: 95%: Wilson for completion and civilian_harm_rate, Student t for means
timing: sim_* and per-episode seconds are wall clock and not deterministic
